Masu binciken jagorori sun ce hakan na iya kawo gano cutar kansa, tarin fuka, HIV da zazzabin cizon sauro ga marasa lafiya a kasashe masu karamin karfi, inda adadin rayuwa ga cututtuka irin su kansar nono zai iya zama rabin na kasashe masu arziki.
JAS 39C Gripen ya yi hatsari a kan filin tashi da saukar jiragen sama da misalin karfe 9:30 na safe agogon gida (0230 UTC) kuma ya fashe, yana rufe filin jirgin sama zuwa jiragen kasuwanci.
An bayyana matukin jirgin a matsayin Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.
Kafofin yada labarai na gida sun ruwaito cewa wata motar kashe gobara ta yi karo da ita yayin da take mayar da martani.
Vidal mai shekaru 28 ya koma kungiyar ta Barça a kakar wasa uku da ta gabata, daga Sevilla.
Tun bayan komawarsa birnin Catalan, Vidal ya buga wa kulob din wasanni 49.
An fara zanga-zangar ne da misalin karfe 11:00 agogon gida (UTC+1) a kan Whitehall dake fuskantar shiga Downing Street, fadar Firayim Minista.
Bayan 11:00, masu zanga-zanga sun toshe zirga-zirga a kan motar jirgin sama a Whitehall.
A 11:20, 'yan sanda sun nemi masu zanga-zangar su koma kan titin, suna cewa suna bukatar daidaita haƙƙin yin zanga-zanga da ginin motoci.

A kusan 11:29, zanga-zangar ta tashi daga Whitehall, ta wuce Trafalgar Square, a kan Strand, ta wuce Aldwych kuma ta hau Kingsway zuwa Holborn inda Jam'iyyar Conservative ta rike ta taron bazata a otal din Grand Connaught Rooms.
Kwararren mai buga wasan da aka yi da Nadal a Kanada ya ci 7-2.
Kwanan nan ya rasa Raonic a Brisbane Open.
Nadal ya samu kashi 88% a raga a wasan da ya lashe maki 76 a wasan farko.
Bayan wasan, Sarkin Clay ya ce, "Ina farin ciki ne kawai don dawowa a zagayen ƙarshe na abubuwan da suka fi muhimmanci. Ina nan don in yi ƙoƙarin lashe wan."
"Panama Papers" kalma ce ta laima ga takardu kimanin miliyan goma daga kamfanin shari'ar Panama Mossack Fonseca, wanda aka fallasa ga manema labarai a cikin bazara na 2016.
Takardun sun nuna bankuna goma sha hudu ne suka taimaka wa masu kudi masu kudi su boye biliyoyin dalar Amurka na dukiya don gujewa haraji da sauran kaidoji.
Jaridar The Guardian ta Birtaniya ta ba da shawarar cewa Deutsche Bank ta mallaki kusan kashi ɗaya bisa uku na kamfanonin shell 1200 da ake amfani da su don cimma wan.
An yi zanga-zanga a duk duniya, an yi tuhumar masu aikata laifuka da dama, kuma shugabannin gwamnatocin Iceland da Pakistan duk sun yi murabus.
An haife shi a Hong Kong, Ma ya yi karatu a Jami'ar New York da Harvard Law School kuma ya taba zama mazaunin dindindin na Amurka "green card".
Hsieh ya nuna a lokacin zaben cewa Ma na iya gudu daga kasar a lokacin da ake cikin rikici.
Hsieh ya kuma yi jayayya cewa Ma mai daukar hoto ya fi salon abu.
Duk da wadan zarge-zarge, Ma ya yi nasara a hannu a kan wani dandali mai fafutukar kulla dangantaka mai zurfi da kasar Sin.
Dan wasan yau na ranar shine Alex Ovechkin na Washington Capitals.
Ya ci kwallaye 2 da kuma taimako 2 a wasan da Washington ta yi nasara a kan Atlanta Thrashers da ci 5-3.

Manyan masu bincike sun ce wannan na iya sa a gano ciwon daji, tarin fuka, ƙanjamau da zazzaɓin cizon sauro da wuri ga marasa lafiya a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗaɗen shiga, inda adadin warkewa na cututtuka kamar sankarar nono zai iya kasancewa rabin na ƙasashe masu arziƙi.
Jirgin JAS 39C Gripen ya faɗo a kan hanyar jirgi da misalin karfe 9:30 na safe lokacin ƙasa (UTC 0230) kuma ya fashe, wanda ya haddasa rufe filin jirgin saman wa jiragen kasuwanci.
An gano cewa matukin jirgin shine Shugaban Rundunar Sojoji Dilokrit Pattavee.
Kafofin watsa labarai na cikin gida sun ce wata motar kashe gobara ta mirgina yayin da take mai da martani.
Vidal dan shekara 28 ya koma Barcelona a kakar wasanni ukun da suka wuce, daga Sevilla.
Tun komawarsa birnin tarayyar Catalan, Vidal ya buga wasanni 49 wa ƙungiyar.
Zanga-zangar ta fara ne misalin ƙarfe 11:00 agogon gida (UTC+1) a Whitehall mai kallon ƙofar shiga da ƴan sanda ke gadi zuwa Layin Downing, gurin zaman Firam minister na hukuma.
Jim kadan bayan ƙarfe 11:00, masu zanga-zangar sun hana zirga-zirgar ababen hawa a kan motar da ta tasanma arewa a Whitehall.
Wajen karfe 11:20 sai yan sandan su ka umarci masu zanga zangar su koma gefen titi saboda kada su shiga haƙƙin ababen hawa da ke zirga zirga a kan titin.

Wajen 11:29, zanga-zangar ta koma Whitehall, gaba da dandalin Trafalgar, a wajajen teku, gittawa ta Aldwych sai kuma ta saman Kingsway zuwa Holborn inda jam'iyyar zaman dako ke gudanar da taron bazararsu a ɗakin otal ɗin Grand Connaught.
Sakamakon nasarar kai da kai na Nadal a kan ɗan kanada 7–2.
Kwanan nan ya sha kayi a hannun Raonic a Brisbane Open.
Nadal ya sami makuna 88% a wasan da yake cin makuna 76 a karo na farko.
Bayan wasan, King of Clay ya ce, "Kawai ina farin ciki akan dawowa cikin zangon ƙarshe na mafi muhimmanci a cikin wasannin. Ina nan ne don ƙoƙarin yin nasarar wannan.
“Panama Papers” wata gamayyar kalma ce wadda ta ƙunshi takardu sama da miliyan goma na wani kamfanin lauyoyi na Panama, Mossack Fonseca, da aka tseguntawa ƴan jarida a shekarar 2016.
Rubutattun hujjoji sun nuna cewa bankuna sha hudu ne su ka taimakawa abokan hurdarsu masu ƙarfin arziƙi don ɓoye dukiyoyi na biliyoyin dalolin Amurka don gujewa biyan haraji da sauran dokoki.
Jaridar The Guardian ta Birtaniya ta nuna cewa Bankin Deutsche ne yake tafiyar da aƙalla ɗaya bisa uku na kaso 1200 na kamfanonin Shell da aka yi amfani da su wajen cimma wannan.
An yi zanga-zanga a duk duniya, gurfanarwa na masu laifuka daban-daban, da shugabannin gwamnatocin Iceland da Pakistan duk sun sauka.
An haife shi a Hong Kong, Ma ya yi karatu a Jami'ar New York da Makarantar Koyon Aikin Shari’a ta Harvard kuma ya taɓa riƙe katin zama a Amurka na dindindin “Green card”.
Hsieh ya yi nuni a lokacin zaben cewa Ma na iya tserewa daga ƙasar yayin rikici.
Hsieh kuma ya bayar da hujjar cewa Ma mai kyau a hoto ya fi salo amman bashi da amfani.
Duk da wadannan zarge-zargen, Ma yayi nasara da kyau a kan aiki a shafin da yake ta kiran a samu alaƙa ta kusa da cikin ƙasar China.
Yau ɗan wasan da yafi nuna ƙwazo shi ne Alex Ovechkin na Washinton Capitals.
Ya ci ƙwallaye 2 da kuma 2 da ya taimaka aka ci a nasarar wasan Washington 5-3 akan Atlanta Thrashers.
